chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves a servant who is easygoing in selling, easygoing in buying, easygoing in settling debts, and easygoing in demanding repayment.

key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula of glorification for Allah
key_terms.سَهْلَ الشِّرَاءِ: easygoing in buying; fair and uncontentious in purchasing
key_terms.سَهْلَ الِاقْتِضَاءِ: easygoing in demanding repayment; gentle and lenient when collecting debts
key_terms.سَهْلَ الْبَيْعِ: easygoing in selling; lenient and pleasant in sales transactions
key_terms.سَهْلَ الْقَضَاءِ: easygoing in settling debts; prompt and gracious in paying what one owes
key_terms.يُحِبُّ: loves; indicates divine approval and pleasure

ai.seo_question: What kind of conduct does Allah love in buying, selling, and debt repayment?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that Allah loves a believer who conducts financial dealings with gentleness and ease. It emphasizes good character in commerce, both when giving others their due and when seeking one's own rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3737 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, loves a servant who is easygoing in selling, easygoing in buying, easygoing in settling debts, and easygoing in demanding repayment."
